text.en: 1. This Order is the Maintenance of Religious Harmony (Application of Sections 16D and 16E) Order 2025 and comes into operation on 1 January 2026.

heading.en: Application of sections 16D and 16E of Act

text.en:
2.—(1) For the purposes of section 16D(1) of the Act, the declared date is 1 January 2026.
(2) For the purposes of section 16E(1) of the Act, the declared date is 1 January 2026.
